title: Buying a Conn trombone and bell size
summary: He bought a silver Conn in town for sixty-some dollars; discussion of six and seven inch bells.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: What kind of trombone were you playing then? Was that the con that you were playing then? Yeah. You bought it here in town?
Yeah, I bought it from Shiki Con. Oh yeah. I bought a good horn soon as I came.
I think in them time it cost me sixty some dollars. That would put a good horn in them days.
I heard in the old days they used a smaller bell. Now they like big bells. Six inch.
That would be the small one?
Would you like the small bell bigger or the smaller? Which is better?

I mean would you like the little one? I think, with my experience, about a seven inch ought to be. That ought to be a little bit better. It gives you a heavier tone. About seven. Yeah. That's about the best of all I was playing. I know that's what I would use. Because I knew that I know it's when they're all in the drum.
